definition.en: The capability of closing a garment with hooks engaging eyes or bars — the flat, strong, adjustable closure of structured intimates and of edge-to-edge fronts. It closes without a lap and without a zip, which is why it is what a bra band and a charro waistcoat both use.
definition.es: La capacidad de cerrar una prenda con corchetes que enganchan en presillas o barras — el cierre plano, resistente y regulable de la lencería estructurada y de los delanteros a tope. Cierra sin montar una parte sobre otra y sin cremallera, y por eso lo usan tanto la banda de un sujetador como un chaleco charro.
definition.fr: La capacité de fermer un vêtement avec des agrafes qui s'engagent dans des portes ou des barrettes — la fermeture plate, solide et réglable de la lingerie structurée et des devants bord à bord. Elle ferme sans croisure et sans glissière, et c'est pourquoi la bande d'un soutien-gorge et un gilet de charro l'emploient toutes deux.
definition.pt: A capacidade de fechar uma peça com colchetes que engatam em presilhas ou barras — o fecho plano, resistente e regulável da lingerie estruturada e das frentes topo a topo. Fecha sem sobreposição e sem fecho de correr, e é por isso que tanto a banda de um soutien como um colete charro o usam.

aliases.name: hook_closure
aliases.note: hyperobject.capabilities key; declared by 15 cartridges and true on 13 as of 2026-09-02, concentrated in the structured-intimates lane.

constraints: A hook set closes on a band that is under tension, so the rows of eyes are a range and not a point: the band is drafted at the tightest row, and the looser rows are what the garment gives back as it is worn in.
notes: NOT the same capability as `hook_loop_closure`, despite the shared word — that is hook-and-LOOP tape. The two bridge to different solid cartridges (yantra4d/hook-and-eye against yantra4d/hook-loop-tape), and the vocabulary records them as explicitly distinct so that a de-duplication pass cannot merge them.
